arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/worktree.test.ts'
s=open(p).read()
a='''			message: "already had uncommitted changes",
			files: "someone else's\\n",
		},'''
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a,a+'''
		{
			name: "doesn't restore into a checkout with untracked files",
			spoil: (s: World) => {
				writeFileSync(join(s.dir, "other.txt"), "someone else's\\n");
			},
			message: "already had uncommitted changes or untracked files",
			files: "base\\n",
		},''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='docs/threads.md'
s=open(p).read()
a='If the checkout has uncommitted changes to tracked files before the restore, pi-action does not restore the snapshot.'
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a,'If the checkout has uncommitted changes or untracked files (that git does not ignore) before the restore, pi-action does not restore the snapshot.')
s=s.replace('If the restore fails, pi-action resets the checkout, and pi starts','If the restore fails, pi-action resets the checkout and removes the untracked files of the restore, and pi starts')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "If the restore fails" docs/threads.md; npx oxfmt >/dev/null; npm run check >/tmp/c.log 2>&1; echo $?; grep -E "error|×|FAIL" /tmp/c.log | head
